vulns.title: invest accepts a whitelist from a different campaign
vulns.root_cause: `invest` checks membership in the supplied whitelist but does not require `whitelist.campaign_id == object::id(campaign)`, so a member of any whitelist can invest in an unrelated admin campaign.

vulns.title: any sender can add themselves to an admin-owned whitelist
vulns.root_cause: `add_member` mutates a shared whitelist without checking `ctx.sender() == whitelist.admin`, allowing an attacker to add themselves and invest through that campaign's whitelist.

vulns.title: any sender can create a whitelist for an admin campaign
vulns.root_cause: `create_whitelist` accepts any campaign reference without checking `ctx.sender() == campaign.admin`, letting an attacker create and administer a whitelist for another admin's campaign.
